nusmp.page.book_explosion.blast_step: A small blast under your heels throws you up to 7 blocks forward; everything you pass through is hit and shoved. Damage scales with the book's mastery and size.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.flash_bang: A bright burst around you hits up to four foes within 4 blocks and blinds them for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.powder_burst: Black powder goes off in front of you: a 6 block cone of small blasts that shoves every foe in it back.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.delayed_charge: Plants a charge where you aim; two seconds later it goes off in 4.5 blocks for about a third more than a normal mid hit, burning and throwing foes back.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.shockwave_ring: A pressure wave rolls out 6 blocks from you, hitting up to six foes and throwing them back and up.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.cluster_bomb: Four small bombs fan out from your hand; each one that lands blows up on its target and sets it alight for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.blast_ward: Wraps you in reactive plates for 10 seconds: two extra hearts of absorption, and anything that hits you in melee is hurt by the backblast.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.blast_leap: You detonate the ground under your feet, hurting foes within 3.5 blocks, and ride the blast high and forward, then float down softly for two seconds.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.carpet_blast: Five blasts walk away from you in a straight line, three blocks apart and five ticks between them, shoving whatever stands in their path.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.volatile_groun: The ground where you aim turns to powder for 5 seconds: every 1.25 seconds it blows up under everything in 5.5 blocks.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.megaton_crater: The book's heaviest charge: one huge blast at the aim point, 7 blocks wide, that burns and hurls up to ten foes. Needs Senior rank.
nusmp.page.book_storm.gust_jab: A hard gust punches out in a 5 block cone and shoves up to four foes back.
nusmp.page.book_storm.static_snap: A crackling spark flies where you look and snaps on impact, hitting everything within 2.5 blocks and slowing it for 1.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_storm.squall_step: You ride a squall 8 blocks forward and knock aside everything on the way.
nusmp.page.book_storm.rain_curtain: A curtain of rain falls around you for 10 seconds: it douses fire (fire resistance) and soaks two hearts of damage.
nusmp.page.book_storm.thunderhead_strike: Calls a bolt out of the cloud deck onto the foe under your crosshair (28 blocks), hurting it for a bit more than a normal mid hit and slowing it.
nusmp.page.book_storm.hailstone_volley: Five hailstones fan out ahead of you; each one slows its target for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_storm.squall_front: A wall of gale rolls 14 blocks ahead of you, 2.5 blocks wide, and drives everything in it back.
nusmp.page.book_storm.downburst: A column of cold air slams down at the aim point, hitting foes within 5 blocks and pinning them with heavy slowness for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_storm.thundercloud: A small thundercloud follows you for 5 seconds and pelts everything within 6 blocks every second, lifting and pushing it.
nusmp.page.book_storm.tempest_barrage: Calls a bolt down on each of up to eight foes within 12 blocks, one after another four ticks apart.
nusmp.page.book_storm.storm_maelstrom: The whole storm collapses into one great whirl at the aim point, 8 blocks wide, that hurls up to ten foes into the air. Needs Senior rank.
